text:
```yaml
name: AI Moderator

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]

jobs:
  ai-moderator:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      issues: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Run AI Moderator
        uses: github/ai-moderator@v1
        with:
          detect-spam: true
          detect-ai-generated: true
          spam-label: spam
          ai-generated-label: ai-generated
          minimize-comments: true
          minimize-comments-label: spam
          minimize-comments-message: "This comment was automatically removed by the AI Moderator."
```
